## Purpose
What user problem or security risk does this change address?

## Scope and evidence
- [ ] Changes are limited to a single coherent behavior
- [ ] Authentication, ownership, consent and administrator access evaluated
- [ ] No credentials, real citizen data or screenshots containing personal information committed
- [ ] Backend tests and PostgreSQL integration checks passed
- [ ] Frontend lint, typecheck and production build passed
- [ ] Migration is additive or documents its rollback/recovery approach
- [ ] API responses preserve stable contracts or document changes
- [ ] Logs do not expose tokens, passwords, complete profiles or secret URLs
- [ ] Monitoring/rollback and release notes updated where applicable

## Validation
List exact tests performed and results; do not claim manual tests that were not run.

## Rollback
State how to disable, revert or recover the feature safely.
